best_for: Windows users with a local music library who want the classic Winamp 5 player back, skins and all, and do not need a version for Mac or Linux.

points.title: The classic player, not a new one
points.text: The builds listed here are Winamp 5.90, 5.91 and 5.92, the line of the desktop player Windows users have known for years. The download comes from Winamp's own server, download.winamp.com.

points.title: Plays far more than MP3
points.text: The installer registers itself for 116 file types, from MP3, AAC, FLAC and MIDI to tracker formats such as MOD and IT, plus playlists like M3U. It also opens Shoutcast and other internet radio links.

points.title: Windows only, 32-bit
points.text: There is one installer, a 32-bit (x86) build that installs for all users and needs Windows 7 SP1 or later. It runs on 64-bit Windows, but there is no native Arm64 build and no Mac or Linux desktop version listed here.

points.title: Updates are rare
points.text: Only three versions exist in this listing, 5.90 to 5.92. If you want a player that changes often, this is not it; if you want one that stays the same, that is the point.

points.title: The company has moved on to artists
points.text: Winamp's website now leads with tools for musicians to manage their music and revenue, next to the player. Expect the player to be a side product rather than the company's main focus.
